plays.name: Forced-Pooling Docket & Non-Consent Mineral Lease Curve-Jumping Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Use public pooling applications and drilling schedules to identify unleased mineral interests before election deadlines, pricing royalty upside against title defects and non-consent cost exposure.
inputs: State pooling dockets and election orders
Mineral ownership chain and lease abstracts
Operator development plans and local lease comparables
workflow: 1. Monitor pooling applications and map affected mineral tracts and hearing dates
2. Verify net mineral acres, ownership authority, and election consequences with specialist counsel
3. Negotiate disclosed lease or option terms and fund obligations before applicable deadlines
4. Assign permitted interests or administer royalty receipts with division-order reconciliation
metrics: Net royalty or assignment proceeds per invested dollar

platform_risks.failure_mode: Missed election or unexpected non-consent penalty
platform_risks.trigger: Stale docket feed or misread state-specific pooling order
platform_risks.impact: Delayed royalties and unbudgeted development-cost exposure
platform_risks.detection_metric: Unverified order changes and days remaining to election
platform_risks.fallback: Stop acquisitions pending counsel review and choose only timely, fully understood permitted elections

plays.name: Fractional Heir-Share Acquisition & Tenancy-in-Common Partition Buyout Forcing
plays.mechanism: Acquire documented fractional heir interests at a discount reflecting illiquidity, then seek consensual buyouts or counsel-supervised partition subject to heirs-property protections and co-owner rights.
inputs: Probate files and verified heirship records
Title chain, occupancy facts, and independent appraisal
Applicable partition and heirs-property protection rules
workflow: 1. Establish ownership fractions, probate authority, and encumbrances before contacting sellers
2. Provide transparent offers with independent-advice opportunity and modeled partition costs
3. Seek voluntary co-owner buyouts or an agreed market sale before considering litigation
4. If unresolved, use counsel-led statutory procedures honoring notice, appraisal, and buyout rights
metrics: Net proceeds after carrying and legal costs

platform_risks.failure_mode: Heirs-property protections defeat assumed forced-sale economics
platform_risks.trigger: Mandatory co-owner buyout, partition-in-kind preference, or defective heirship
platform_risks.impact: Long holding period and lower realizable value
platform_risks.detection_metric: Unresolved heirs and statutory buyout conditions per property
platform_risks.fallback: Renegotiate voluntary exits or retain the interest without threatening unavailable remedies

plays.name: Cell-Tower, Rooftop & Billboard Perpetual Easement Strip-Out Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Separate assignable site-access and rent rights from underlying real estate for specialist buyers, pricing tenant termination rights and the permanent burden left on the residual property.
inputs: Tower, rooftop, and billboard leases and amendments
Title, lender consent, and zoning documents
Specialist easement-buyer bids and residual property appraisals
workflow: 1. Identify leased sites and reconcile actual rent receipts with termination and renewal terms
2. Verify assignment rights, mortgage restrictions, maintenance duties, and required consents
3. Compare easement sale proceeds against lost rent and residual property impairment
4. Close approved conveyances through escrow and record access, utilities, and rent-allocation rights
metrics: Net easement proceeds versus retained rent value

platform_risks.failure_mode: Nonassignable lease or excessive permanent property burden
platform_risks.trigger: Missing tenant or lender consent or easement scope exceeding valued rights
platform_risks.impact: Failed closing or reduced refinancing and resale value
platform_risks.detection_metric: Unresolved consent conditions and residual appraisal discount
platform_risks.fallback: Retain the lease or negotiate a narrower term-limited assignment with all required approvals

plays.name: FERC / ISO Substation Interconnection Queue & Powered-Land Option Flipping
plays.mechanism: Overlay public interconnection queues with land-use and substation data to option potentially useful sites, treating queue position and nearby infrastructure as signals rather than guaranteed deliverable power.
inputs: ISO and utility interconnection queues and study results
Parcel zoning, transmission corridors, and substation maps
Utility service estimates and developer site requirements
workflow: 1. Match queue activity and infrastructure constraints to suitable parcels
2. Verify site control requirements, zoning, environmental limits, and utility capacity assumptions
3. Negotiate assignable diligence-contingent options within capped carrying-cost budgets
4. Assign approved options to qualified developers with explicit disclosure of unresolved power and study conditions
metrics: Option cost per qualified developable acre
Net assignment proceeds after study and option costs

platform_risks.failure_mode: Queue withdrawal or prohibitive network upgrade cost
platform_risks.trigger: Restudy, milestone failure, or capacity estimate unsupported by utility commitments
platform_risks.impact: Option expiry and unrecoverable diligence spending
platform_risks.detection_metric: Study cost revisions and unresolved interconnection milestones
platform_risks.fallback: Let contingent options lapse or reposition land for independently viable uses without claiming secured power

plays.name: TCPA Serial-Plaintiff Docket Scraping & Real-Time Litigator-Scrub Firewall Tollbooth
plays.mechanism: Offer consent-first outbound compliance screening using lawful docket-derived risk signals alongside mandatory do-not-call and revocation checks; plaintiff matching neither authorizes contact nor replaces TCPA compliance.
inputs: Permitted public docket data with identity confidence scores
Consent provenance, revocations, and suppression lists
Applicable calling rules and customer retention policies
workflow: 1. Ingest permitted docket records with source dates, minimization, and human identity review
2. Check consent, do-not-call status, revocations, and calling restrictions before optional risk enrichment
3. Suppress noncompliant contacts and route uncertain matches to review without planting honeypots or provoking claims
4. Serve auditable screening decisions with correction, deletion, and retention controls
metrics: Contacts blocked for missing consent or suppression match

platform_risks.failure_mode: False identity match or false assurance of permission to call
platform_risks.trigger: Stale docket data or treating absence from a plaintiff list as consent
platform_risks.impact: Unlawful outreach, privacy complaints, and customer liability
platform_risks.detection_metric: Consent-audit failure rate and upheld identity correction requests
platform_risks.fallback: Disable uncertain enrichment and require independently verified consent and authoritative suppression checks
